line.en: A sheet feeding up out of a typewriter on a walnut desk, typed letter by letter, a phrase in red ribbon, pencil in the margin, a stamp to file it.
line.zh-CN: 胡桃木桌上一页从打字机里送出的纸，逐字敲出，一句用红色色带，页边铅笔批注，最后盖章归档。

for.en: Quotations and book notes, reading lists, a method in a few steps, a small typed account of real figures: literary, historical and study films told in words.
for.zh-CN: 引文与读书笔记、书单、几步方法、一小张打出来的真实账目：用文字讲的文学、历史与学习类短片。

not.en: Anything that needs a picture, a diagram, a map or motion of things: it only types words. Fast loud promos.
not.zh-CN: 需要画面、示意图、地图或物体运动的内容：它只会打字。节奏快而喧闹的宣传片。
